description: USGS 3D Elevation Program seamless 1/3 arc-second (about 10 m) DEM: the 1449 1 x 1 degree GeoTIFF tiles under `StagedProducts/Elevation/13/TIFF/current/` in the USGS `prd-tnm` S3 bucket, as downloaded by `_shared/scripts/download_raw.sh usgs-3dep`, plus the USGS VRT that mosaics them from S3. Covers CONUS, Hawaii, the territories and the parts of Alaska with 1/3 arc-second data. Tiles are float32 metres (NAVD88 in CONUS), EPSG:4269, 10812 x 10812 with a 6-pixel overlap, nodata -999999, and are named by their north-west corner; each asset's `proj:bbox` is the tile's nominal 1 x 1 degree cell. Source dates vary by tile. Read-only.
title: USGS 3DEP 1/3 arc-second DEM (raw)
